title: The Ledger of Vilna
author: Kestrel Iversen
blurb: Cyrus Amberdale, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent ten years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
